notes.title: Making the Dragon Guide Free
notes.notes:
Thank you to the few of you that purchased the game, I was optimistic that I would keep updating it and it's still deep down my to-do list.

I'm planning on making the game free (pending Steam approval), so if you enjoyed it at all, feel free to tell your friends about it. 

Perhaps, if there are a few more players, updating will move up my to-do list!

Thank you for your support!
